summary: Tested Sauna Calculator variant selection feature. All tests passed - variants display correctly in calculator, prices replace base option price, and admin panel shows variant management UI.

variant_prices_correct.details: Bez zabudowy = 480 PLN, Z zabudową = 1480 PLN

variant_price_replacement.details: Selecting 'Z zabudową' shows 1480 PLN in summary (replaces base 480 PLN)

admin_panel_variant_ui.details: Edit dialog shows '🔄 Варианты исполнения / Warianty' section with existing variants and add new variant form
